title: TFC Recruits
description: This is a fork of TFCWorkers without the Workers to allow people to use only the Recruits in their TFC worlds if they do not want to bother with the workers.
body:
**This is a fork of TFCWorkers without the Workers to allow people to use only the Recruits in their TFC worlds if they do not want to bother with the workers.**

**Original mod:**

[TFCWorkers](https://modrinth.com/mod/workerstfc)

Features:

- Instead of unobtainable vanilla emeralds, recruits and workers now use a Coin wich can be made from precious metals in the TFC anvil
- Recruits fully function with TFC as expected, eating TFC food, riding TFC horse, wearing TFC gear etc...
- Villagers are now obtainable in TFC via curing Zombies with a TFC-Esque Weakness potion substitute
- Recruits using weapons such as the Heavy Crossbow, or the Longbow from EpicKnights deal more damage, but take longer to load.


LINKS TO DEPENDENCIES:

https://modrinth.com/mod/villager-recruits

https://modrinth.com/mod/terrafirmacraft

DISCLAIMER: The Mod is still in initial development fase, expect bugs and instability!
